title: manufacturing.transfer_items input
description: The packages a transfer request names, in the request's order (MP-R15).

record_id.description: The package record's id (the web form's qty_<id> key, ASCII digits; the phone's JSON integer).

qty.description: The quantity as the form has it (text) or the phone's whole number; blank text names nothing, anything but 1 to 6 ASCII digits is refused.
